note: thirdjam's sound in our engine (lane K6). 'events': per event name and Variant, per Strength step, the takes: {file, gain}. law 'gain': the sound only scales with Strength (one file; the gain between steps is a straight line). law 'steps': the step at or below the Strength is played. A file is Unreal's own render of the event's MetaSound (engine/tools/arena/render_audio.py), cut to its sound, nothing else. 'loops': the held sounds' sources and the numbers of their rules (rink_audio.gd).

out_gain.note: What Unreal's output does to a 2D sound, measured on its own render of the held sounds (render_audio.py, jobs_cal.json): MS_music_match at Level 1 comes out at 0.706 of its wave, MS_crowd_bed at 0.721 of this bake's low-passed bed (residual 5.8 %), the mono MS_skate_loop at 0.52 (Speed 1) and 0.51 (Speed 0.5) of this port's model. The one-shots' files are Unreal's output already; the held sounds' gains are multiplied by these.

music.source: MS_music_match: Wave Player (loop) x InterpTo(clamp(Level, 0, 1), 0.5 s); CommentarySystem.h:46-47, CommentarySystem.cpp:938-943

crowd_bed.source: MS_crowd_bed: Wave Player (loop) -> Biquad low-pass (3000 + 6000 x Excite Hz, bandwidth 1) x Level x 2 x (Excite + 1); thirdjam starts it and never sets Level or Excite (CommentarySystem.cpp:922-930)

skate.source: MS_skate_loop: mixer(1.0 x [0.25 x band-pass(pink noise, 1200 + 2500 x Speed Hz, bandwidth 1.5) x 3 x Speed], 1.4 x stride loop pitched 4 x Speed - 2 semitones x Speed, 0.8 x carve on Turn) x FxTrim; Speed and Turn: CommentarySystem.cpp:945-968, CommentarySystem.h:48-49
